text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 8: Summed Physical Notifications reproduce INDDEM to within 5 MW in 125 of 192 half-hours and miss it by up to 0.3 GW'
text.tspan: Figure 8: Summed Physical Notifications reproduce INDDEM to within 5 MW
in 125 of 192 half-hours and miss it by up to 0.3 GW

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Solid: INDDEM (orange, sign reversed) and INDGEN (blue), the latest issue before each half-hour. Dashed: the same quantity summed from the final PNs of every BMU, which Elexon serves now. The sum for a half-hour is the time- weighted mean of each BMU's notified level, with imports and exports summed apart.'
text.tspan: Solid: INDDEM (orange, sign reversed) and INDGEN (blue), the latest issue before each half-hour. Dashed: the same
quantity summed from the final PNs of every BMU, which Elexon serves now. The sum for a half-hour is the time-
weighted mean of each BMU's notified level, with imports and exports summed apart.
